name: Resty API Testing CLI
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local CLI for REST API tests in Markdown/YAML files, with variables, response assertions/capture, and text/JSON/JUnit XML/HTML reports; no vendor-imposed test or seat quota documented.
watch_out: Requires local .NET build/runtime or a self-contained build. No hosted testing infrastructure is included; API endpoints and external services may charge separately. The CLI's own software has no subscription or expiry.
